about: Run views (docs/runs-v1.md section 7): window.IORunViews[id] = {name, description, order, mount(ctx), unmount(ctx), update(ctx), open(id, ctx), runLine(util, run, ctx)}. One entry per proposal, pre-listed; the page loads runs/<file> only for entries with ready=true and lists every one that registered mount() in the bottom-right Prototype picker ('Runs'). A proposal lane flips ONLY its own line to ready and rewrites ONLY its own file (entries are blank-line separated so parallel lanes merge cleanly).
